root.label: Smithsonian museum dispute and executive order

events.label: Smithsonian museum dispute and executive order

slots.name: executive order date
slots.sentence: In a July executive order, Trump ordered the installation of disclaimers outside of the Smithsonian National Museum of American History to warn visitors that some of its exhibits did not match his version of the nation’s past.

slots.name: testimony date
slots.sentence: The museum’s director, Anthea Hartig, told lawmakers in July that the report failed to “fairly or accurately” depict the museum’s exhibits and stressed the museum “does not take sides in America’s political debates.”
